expected.reason: config/agents/reviewer.md sets the effort for reviewer. CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL beats the agent's effort frontmatter, which beats --effort and the settings that count for its own model.

config/agents/reviewer.md sets the model for reviewer. The agent's frontmatter model, inherit included, beats CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, which beats the main model, unless CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE is on. A model passed at dispatch, or set by a mod's agent.spawn hook, beats the frontmatter, and the dashboard can't see either.

config/agents/scribe.md sets the model for scribe. The agent's frontmatter model, inherit included, beats CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, which beats the main model, unless CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE is on. config/settings.json sets a top-level effortLevel of xhigh, and that level may not reach the session. Opus 5.5 and models released after it ignore this key in the user file, and earlier models use it. The dashboard doesn't know the session's model, so it can't say which level the session runs at. To check, run /effort status in a new session started in this project.
projects/driftwood/.claude/settings.local.json sets the model. --model beats ANTHROPIC_MODEL, which beats the model key in any file, managed included.
